PATTERN: For Windows port development:
1. Write all code on macOS with Claude Code
2. Validate with `cargo xwin check --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` (catches Rust compile errors, not C build or link)
3. Push commits
4. On UTM Windows ARM: git pull → install Vulkan SDK + VS Build Tools + Node → cargo build → npm run tauri dev
5. UTM Windows ARM on M4 Pro is fast enough (no x86 emulation needed for Windows ARM)

WHEN: Every Windows port iteration
WHY: Cross-compile validates Rust logic; native Windows build needed for C deps (Vulkan SDK) and actual testing. UTM networking works (confirmed). M4 Pro handles compilation in UTM fine.

NOTE: GitHub Actions Windows runner is the alternative if UTM iteration is too slow, but UTM is the primary path.
